maddeler.e:
أتصابر (form VI)
# أَتَصَابَرُ (ʔataṣābaru) /ʔa.ta.sˤaː.ba.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَصَابَرَ (taṣābara)
# أَتَصَابَرَ (ʔataṣābara) /ʔa.ta.sˤaː.ba.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَصَابَرَ (taṣābara)
# أَتَصَابَرْ (ʔataṣābar) /ʔa.ta.sˤaː.bar/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَصَابَرَ (taṣābara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
